purpose: Independent single-statement regression cases selected from Trino 483 grammar gaps and executed by pytest without Java.

source.attribution: Original reduced examples derived from the syntax of Apache Trino 483. Existing family coverage was checked in local pytest sources and collected parameters, not inferred from grammar alone.

contract.warnings_authority: Project catalog-name contract; native parser confirms only syntax acceptance, not warnings or engine semantics.
contract.dedup_scope: Collected pytest parameters and literal strings in tests/test*.py, whitespace/case folded for duplicate candidates; this is not a proof that equivalent SQL is absent.
contract.coverage_claim: Selected alternative and interaction coverage only; not 100% of Trino grammar or execution semantics.

error_location_contract.offset_unit: Zero-based Unicode code-point offset into the exact SQL input, not UTF-8 byte offset.
error_location_contract.position_unit: One-based line and column; LF advances the line, CRLF is one line break, columns count Unicode code points rather than display width.
error_location_contract.matching: Convert the reported line/column to a source offset; it must equal one of expected.error_location.anchors[].offset. For each anchor verify sql[offset:] starts with text.
error_location_contract.eof: An empty anchor text is allowed only at offset == len(sql); this denotes end of input.
error_location_contract.transformations: Remap anchors and warning positions to the exact wrapper/multiline/Unicode input; do not retain coordinates from the unmodified SQL.
error_location_contract.authority: Reviewed offending or incomplete syntactic construct. Native parser validity is authoritative; its message and chosen error position are not required to match Rust.
error_location_contract.review: Alternative anchors must identify the same concrete defect, not an arbitrary point in the statement; changing the set requires review.

diagnostic_baseline_v019.note: Schema v2 adds normative error anchors without changing SQL or native validity labels. The syntax summary remains unchanged; these diagnostic failures are additional assertions, not independent parser bug families.

within_group.gap: Restriction to the unquoted LISTAGG production, nested and CTAS contexts; existing LISTAGG positives are not evidence for rejection of generic WITHIN GROUP.

table_function.gap: Contextual COPARTITION aliases and mixed descriptor/table/scalar arguments; table arguments in general are already tested.

json_encoding.gap: Encoding in context item, PASSING, constructor and RETURNING positions; encoding in JSON_TABLE column types is already tested.

json_table_plan.gap: Specific/default PLAN alternatives and their combinations; basic nested JSON_TABLE columns are already tested.

window_pattern.gap: Window MEASURES/PATTERN, measure reference and named window; relation MATCH_RECOGNIZE is not window coverage.

row_pattern.gap: Anchors, empty patterns, contextual skip targets, INITIAL/SEEK and repeated quantifiers; retain already supported permutation/exclusion as controls.

grammar_edges.gap: Partial predicates in simple CASE, MATCH/UNIQUE predicates and array wildcard; named fields, string dereference and quoted identifiers are controls.
